## Reproduction rules

**write-feedback clause 1** — 1. As admin, make a draft of a scratch-package object (Studio label rename, or `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/OBJ?mode=draft&package=PKG`). 2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/object/OBJ`. 3. Click "Discard draft", accept the native confirm. Expected: a toast naming the label ("QA Widget"). Actual: `Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget` (the confirm also reads `…for object/uxscratch_widget?`). Source: objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`tFormat('engine.edit.draftDiscarded', …, { type, name })`) and `i18n.ts` key `'Draft discarded: {type}/{name}'`; unchanged on objectui main `d66ceea5`.

**disabled-control-reason clauses 0–2** — 1. As admin open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object%3Ashowcase_task`. 2. Click "Validations"; rule "Task Status Flow" opens. 3. Hover the Severity combobox ("error (rejects the save)") 1.5 s: no `[role=tooltip]`; no title / aria-describedby / tabindex on it or its ancestors. 4. Tab through the page: no form control receives focus. Expected: hover and keyboard reach "Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit." as the Publish button and Enabled toggle do. Reproduced on 2 fresh loads with `hover()` and coordinate hover, after a screenshot confirmed render.

**labels-over-machine-names clause 0 (a)** — Studio → any package → Access → Explain access; User = a member, Object = any; Explain. Principal card "Positions:" / "Permission sets:" chips show `org_member`, `showcase_member_default`…; labels exist (`GET /api/v1/meta/position/org_member` → "Organization Member"). `POST /api/v1/security/explain` returns names only in `principal.positions` / `permissionSets`.

**labels-over-machine-names clause 0 (b)** — In a scratch package: Studio → Interfaces → create an app with "Add this package's objects as menu items"; select the object nav item; Properties → LIST VIEW → "Columns" chips read the field names (`title`, `owner_ref`) where the labels are "Widget Name" / "Owner Ref"; no title attribute.

Dispositions: all product defects whose fix lands in objectui — extracted there (see close-out comment).

## Fixture gaps

- showcase_task has no create-time validation rule (`task_status_flow` runs on update only), so "create with a value that breaks a validation rule" is not drivable; the server-refusal half used the kanban state-machine move.
- The stock member persona holds no update/delete on showcase_task, so the member inline-edit, bulk-delete and kanban rows cannot be driven.
- No stock surface disables a submit button (disabled-control variant 5); no Undo anywhere (write-feedback clause 5).

2. write-feedback acceptance[3] expects a 4xx for the required-field case; the console blocks in the browser and sends no request — the oracle should admit that shape.
3. write-feedback variants: the "Approvals inbox" link opens the review-queue page, the decision drawer is at `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/system/approvals`; the grid has no "Edit inline" button (double-click + Save row / Save All).
4. disabled-control-reason knownGaps[1] is stale for Studio Publish and import Next — both keyboard-reachable with a description now.
5. labels-over-machine-names knownGaps[0] (objectui#11862) is mostly stale (permission-set list, Changes panel, Display-field picker now pass) and the #23157 principal-prose row looks fixed ("Principal Mia Member (member.ux@example.com; id …)"); clause 3 does not say whether ADR references in server prose or tracker ids inside authored labels count.
